title: Bring Back & Bring In
situation: Returning tools and bringing new supplies into the office.
objective: Use bring back and bring in to talk about returning and moving things inside.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When I finish a task, I bring back the tools to the storage room.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah menyelesaikan tugas, saya mengembalikan alat ke ruang penyimpanan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I always bring back the test bag after the check.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya selalu mengembalikan tas uji setelah pemeriksaan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: In the morning, I bring in the new spare parts from the delivery box.
dialogue.indonesian: Pada pagi hari, saya membawa masuk suku cadang baru dari kotak pengiriman.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My teammate helps me bring in the heavy box.
dialogue.indonesian: Rekan kerja saya membantu saya membawa masuk kotak yang berat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Please bring back the radio when you finish your shift.
dialogue.indonesian: Tolong kembalikan radio setelah shift selesai.

learningNotes: bring back berarti membawa sesuatu kembali ke tempat asalnya.
bring in berarti membawa sesuatu dari luar ke dalam.
Untuk pronoun, letakkan di tengah: bring it back, bring it in.
